FIRST AMENDMENT 
 to Digital Marketing Agreement by and between 
 
 Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“Zameen”) and House Building Company Limited ( “Customer”) 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 
 This First Amendment (“ First Amendment ”) to the Digital Marketing Agreement dated 1 st August , 20 19 (“ Agreement ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this 1 st day of September, 201 9 (“ Effective Date ”) . 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 Parties entered into the Agreement for the purpose of advertisement of various financial/ bank ing facilities and services offered by the Customer on the website of Zameen namely, www.zameen.com (the “ Website ”) ; and 
 
 Pursuant to Clause 1.2 of the Agreement, Parties hereby mutually agree to extend the Term of the Agreement for one month and to modify the payment structure of the Service Fee of the Agreement, as per the provisions of this First Amendment . 
 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 
 The Term of the Agreement shall be extended for an additional period of 1 (one) month, i.e. ending on 28 th February , 2020, unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing between the Parties . 
 
 As of the Effective Date, Clause 4 .1 of the Agreement pertaining to the payment of the Service fee, is revised and restated as follows: 
 
 “ 4.1 Customer shall pay Service Fee to Zameen in the following manner: 
 
 4.1.1 f irst amendment amounting to Rs. 600,000 (Rupees six hundred thousand) shall be paid on or before 1 st September, 2019 (the “ First Instalment ”); 
 
 4.1.2 second instalmen t amounting to amounting to Rs. 480,000 (Rupees four hundred and eighty thousand) shall be paid on or before 1st December, 2019 (the “ Second Instalment ” ) ; 
 
 4.1.3 third instalment amounting to Rs.120,000 (Rupees one hundred and twenty thousand) shall be paid within 3 (three) days of delivery of Performance Report by Zameen to the Customer (the “ Third Instalment ”).” 
 
 The First Amendment shall remain in force fro m the Effective Date. 
 
 This First Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 
 Al l other terms and provisions of the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the terms of this First Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this First Amendment , unless otherwise specified. 
 
 This First Amendment may be entered into in counterparts , all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same amendment . 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Amendment , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses . 
 
 SIGNED

 For and on behalf of Zameen For and on behalf of Customer
